summary: TruGolf Holdings filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026 disclosing a Separation and Settlement Agreement with Christopher Jones, its former officer, plus affiliates and the Audree Redd Jones Trust. Terms include $100,000 severance, up to 12 months of COBRA premiums, repayment of a $1,444,000 demand loan (10% at initial payment, 90% at 12 months, 12% simple interest), and a $500,000 buyback of franchise rights. Jones must vote Class B shares with board recommendations for one year, with mutual releases and consulting at $100/hour. Watch governance overhang, liquidity, and loan repayment risk.
